notes.fielding: No fielding statistics: the supplied data has no fielder IDs.
notes.pressure: The pressure split is descriptive and rule-based. It is separate from the supplied headline composite rank and score, which are never recomputed.
notes.legal_balls: Wides and Overstep (no-balls) are not legal balls.
notes.bowler_runs: Bowlers are charged bat runs plus extras1 on wides, Overstep and other extras; byes, leg-byes and penalties are not charged.
notes.wickets: Run-outs, retired-out and obstructing the field are not bowler wickets.
notes.exclusions: Super overs (innings 3 and 4), the two Emerging tournaments, and DLS/shortened matches are excluded.
notes.percentiles: Percentiles compare the selected split with career values of qualified players (batters: >= 100 balls; bowlers: >= 120 legal balls).

batting.matches: Matches in which the player appeared in the XI within the split.
batting.innings: Batting innings with at least one delivery as striker.
batting.not_outs: Batting innings in which the striker was not dismissed.
batting.runs: Bat runs only; wides, no-balls, byes and leg-byes are excluded.
batting.balls: Balls faced: wides excluded, no-balls included (standard batter ball count).
batting.highest: Highest score in an innings in the split.
batting.golden_ducks: Dismissed for 0 having faced at most one ball.
batting.boundary_pct: Boundary runs (4s and 6s) as a share of bat runs.
batting.dot_pct: Share of balls faced with zero bat runs.
batting.position: Most used batting position in the XI within the split.
batting.entry: Average entry point, in overs, at the first ball faced in an innings.

bowling.matches: Matches in which the player appeared in the XI within the split.
bowling.innings: Bowling innings with at least one delivery.
bowling.legal_balls: Deliveries that are not wides or Overstep no-balls.
bowling.runs: Bat runs plus chargeable extras (wides, Overstep, other).
bowling.dot_pct: Legal balls with no runs charged.
bowling.maidens: Complete six-ball overs with zero runs charged.
bowling.best: Best innings figures, wickets first then runs.
bowling.speed: Recorded bowl_speed values greater than zero; plausible range 50-160 km/h shown separately.
